zh.title: 星宇航空空山金與空山銀雙機首度於東京成田機場同框展示
zh.summary: 星宇航空空山金藝術機20日首飛東京成田；雙機展示並預計10月投入定期航班
body: 星宇航空與日本藝術家空山基合作打造的A350-1000藝術機「空山金」，於2026年8月20日由星宇航空董事長張國煒親自執飛。該航班於台北時間上午8時30分自桃園國際機場起飛，並於東京時間中午12時51分順利飛抵東京成田國際機場。
本次航班抵達後，「空山金」與「空山銀」首度於東京成田國際機場停機坪並肩同框展示。這也是星宇航空繼「空山銀」於7月亮相後，兩架旗艦級A350-1000藝術機首度共同亮相。
根據星宇航空規劃，這兩架「空山金」與「空山銀」藝術機預計將於2026年10月1日起正式投入定期航班服務，營運航線將涵蓋東京、鳳凰城及布拉格等熱門國際航線。

en.title: STARLUX Airlines Displays Sorayama Gold and Silver Aircraft Together at Tokyo Narita
en.summary: STARLUX Airlines flew Sorayama Gold to Tokyo Narita on August 20, displaying twin art aircraft together.
body: STARLUX Airlines Chairman K.W. Chang piloted the carrier's Airbus A350-1000 art livery aircraft, named Sorayama Gold, from Taoyuan International Airport to Tokyo Narita International Airport on August 20, 2026. The flight departed Taoyuan at 08:30 Taipei time and arrived at Narita at 12:51 Tokyo time.

Following its arrival, Sorayama Gold was displayed side-by-side with sister aircraft Sorayama Silver on the apron at Tokyo Narita International Airport. This marked the first time both flagship art aircraft appeared together following the unveiling of Sorayama Silver in July.

According to STARLUX Airlines, both art-themed aircraft are scheduled to formally enter regular commercial passenger service starting October 1, 2026. The aircraft will operate on major international routes, including services to Tokyo, Phoenix, and Prague.
